THE DETAILS

Instrument notes.

Documented by the retailer for this listing.

  • Similar in shape and size to a Gibson ES339. A smaller body is preferred by many players
  • Gibson 490 pickups
  • Jumbo frets
  • Built locally in New Lenox, IL!
  • Carved top and back
  • Body is all maple, with flat out beautiful, three-dimensional figuring to the transparent blue finish.
  • Neck is mahogany with a rosewood fretboard.
  • Electronics inside are American-made!
  • Fantastic setup - this guitar plays very well!
  • Includes soft case.
  • Finish on rear shows some wear. Please see all photos.
